whole_code_inventory.claim_boundary: The original counts 162 quantitative markers, 198 outside-code digits, 163 negation markers, and 89 purpose markers describe surface features. They do not estimate prevalence of semantically quantified, negative or purpose requirements. This disagreement audit is not a population correction or precision/recall estimate.
whole_code_inventory.measurement_definition: A stated physical, monetary, temporal-duration or item-count magnitude; excludes tariff/CAS/material-grade/standard identifiers and statutory dates. Minimum named component inventories are recorded separately.
whole_code_inventory.whole_code_boundary_note: The frozen whole_code flag means exactly one standalone statistical code (41 records). Two additional code-only descriptions contain historical code replacements and dates and are not marked by that strict regex. They should not silently be counted as physical product descriptions; report 41 standalone codes plus 2 temporal code-only entries when using semantic scope categories.
whole_code_inventory.data_product_scope: A versioned machine-readable transcription of one official USTR index; not a complete historical legal ontology or an independently expert-coded corpus.

review_scope: Evidence/numeric/selection claims only. New neural experiments and other agents’ output are outside this audit; placeholders are not treated as defects.
